findings.title: Manual acknowledgement can clear a still-live relative request after context reset
findings.sourceEvidence: Changing catalog type/context calls reset(), closes the dialog and clears local busy while the actual PUT promise continues. Reopening the same owner/product exposes the persisted marker, a fresh GET and an acknowledgement button. acknowledgeStockRead() removes the marker without checking whether that owner/product still has a live API request. A second relative PUT can begin before the first returns.
findings.requiredResolution: Prevent acknowledgement and new relative submission while a request for the same owner/product is still pending; retain unknown-outcome manual reconciliation only after the request settles. Add the real SFC/Axios delayed-PUT, same-owner catalog-out-and-back regression.

resolutionHistory.result: API tracks owner/product in-flight requests, holds an exclusive origin Web Lock for request/marker operations when supported, rejects pending acknowledgement and rechecks current persisted token/session within the lock. Dialog awaits acknowledgement under its epoch/token/session stamp. Follow-up requested: a GET completed during an existing pending write must not remain eligible as the fresh read used for later manual acknowledgement.

Dialog now sets freshRead=false when its same-owner/product PUT remains pending and shows an explicit wait-then-reread message. A pre-completion read cannot be used for acknowledgement after the request settles without a new read. Web Locks protect marker/request/ack operations across supported browser tabs; unsupported browser fallback is per-tab only.

findings.title: Missing configuration keys have no lock against an active uncooperative insertion path
findings.sourceEvidence: The stock writer takes ERP and commerce advisory locks and FOR SHARE on existing config rows, but does not validate the candidate ERP config trigger. Active POST /api/admin/config/save calls AdminConfigBatchService.save: erp_open/store_stock are permitted, missing keys are inserted, and the writer takes only SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on system_config for these ordinary keys. Stock SELECT FOR SHARE acquires ROW SHARE table lock, compatible with that table mode; no existing erp_open row can be locked when the key is absent. Without a verified ERP trigger, the generic batch may insert erp_open=1 after the final stock config read and before stock commit.
findings.requiredResolution: Use a real table barrier covering missing inserts and existing mutations, or make a verified complete config-write handshake an admission requirement. Add a native two-connection missing-key insertion regression; retain NOWAIT/retry semantics.
findings.runtimeStatus: Not executed by reviewer; active writer and absence of admission barrier inspected from source.
